predictive-policing.platform_note: Leading security agencies are adopting predictive policing that uses AI and big-data analysis to anticipate crime. Applied in Singapore and the United Kingdom. Linked to strengthening follow-up and smart monitoring.

ai-policing.platform_note: AI is reshaping security operations from planning to execution: identifying suspects, analyzing crimes and managing human resources. Europol leads AI initiatives in Europe. Linked to foresight capability and forecasting accuracy.

digital-twin.platform_note: A digital twin of security systems can simulate new security policies and scenarios in a virtual environment before real-world implementation. UNODC uses it to model counter-crime strategies.
